title: The AI Prompt Formula in 30 Seconds
style: Read this like a funny, energetic friend in a quick social video. Playful on the joke, then clear and upbeat.

segments.title: You: "write an email." AI: writes a novel.
segments.say: You ask AI to write a quick email, and it writes you a novel. Sound familiar? Here is the fix, in four words. Who. What. Details. Format.

segments.title: Try it like this
bullets: WHO: act as my store manager
WHAT: write a reply to this customer
DETAILS: the facts and the tone
segments.say: Who: give it a role, like, act as my store manager. What: the job, write a reply to this customer. Details: the facts and the tone you want. Format: friendly, three sentences.

chat.user: Act as my store manager. Write a reply to a customer asking when their sofa arrives. Friendly, 3 sentences.
chat.ai: Hi Sarah, thanks for checking in! Your sofa is scheduled for Thursday between 10 AM and 2 PM. We'll text you when the driver is 30 minutes away.

segments.title: Like & subscribe for more
bullets: Better details in, better answers out
segments.say: Better details in, better answers out. If that helped, hit like and subscribe to Run It With AI for a new lesson every week.
